report.summary: Both UI book tests fail at the same spot: the page object clicks a test id that does not exist. BooksPage.add in tests/support/pages.py:44 looks for get_by_test_id("add-books"), but books.html:9 renders the button as data-testid="add-book". Fix the selector in pages.py first, then rerun to see whether the future-year test's downstream assertions hold.

causes.title: Page object uses the wrong test id for the Add book button
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), which matches no element, so Playwright waits 5s and times out before any book is submitted. The application template names the button "add-book" (singular). The app is correct, so this is a test-side locator error. Both failing tests call BooksPage.add(), which is why they fail identically. The failure happens before any app behaviour is exercised, so neither test has been checked against the feature yet.
evidence: Call log: "waiting for get_by_test_id(\"add-books\")" (Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 both fail at books.add(...) via pages.py:44
causes.suggested_fix: Change tests/support/pages.py:44 to self.page.get_by_test_id("add-book").click(). Optionally, check the other test ids in pages.py against the templates while you are there; they currently match. After the fix, rerun both tests. If test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input still fails, investigate its assertions separately, since it has not yet reached them.
